Name: Make Sam Prompto
Author: DiStri
Description:
Hello! This is my first time modding... well, anything. This is a simple sprite replacement that changes Sam's appearance to that of Prompto Argentum from Final Fantasy 15. Sam is my favorite husband, but he didn't look enough like my other favorite husband. ;)
[b][s]

[/s]Now Content Patcher compatible! [/b]Sorry it took so long!


[b]How to Install[/b]:

Be sure to have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed. Just unzip the file and slap the [b][CP] Make Sam Prompto[/b] folder into your Mods folder. Enjoy!

Don't hesitate to contact me if you have issues getting the sprites to work. Thanks!

Downloads.Description: An updated Content Patcher version of the old xnb file replacement.

Manifest.Name: Make Sam Prompto
Manifest.Description: Replaces the sprites and portraits for Sam to make him Prompto from FFXV.
